visual_action: The video displays a static screenshot of a fabricated tweet from LeBron James endorsing Kamala Harris. This is followed by a cut to a separate static image of LeBron James smiling shirtless while in a swimming pool.

cast.name: LeBron James
cast.evidence: A fabricated tweet from his account '@KingJames' is shown, and a photograph of his face is displayed.

cast.name: Kamala Harris
cast.evidence: Her name appears in an overlay text ("endorsed Kamala Harris") and in the text of a fabricated tweet ("VOTE KAMALA HARRIS!!!").

on_screen_text.text: The 👑 just officially endorsed Kamala Harris ⬇️⬇️
What are we even talking about here?? When I think about my kids and my family and how they will grow up, the choice is clear to me. VOTE KAMALA HARRIS!!!
Smiling through it all! Can’t believe this my life

spoken_summary: There is no dialogue in the video; it is accompanied by a song.
audio_music: A soulful, slightly dramatic song ('Forever' by Joel Venom, Nick Nemesis) plays throughout the video. Its serious tone is used ironically to contrast with the mocking content.
editing_pacing: A simple slideshow consisting of a single cut between two static images.
manipulation_or_satire: The post features a fabricated screenshot of a tweet from LeBron James's official account, falsely showing him endorsing Kamala Harris.
central_claim: The post fabricates a political endorsement from LeBron James for Kamala Harris to mock him as out of touch or hypocritical.
intended_effect: To mock LeBron James and, by extension, celebrity political endorsements.
